notes.name: CONMED Corporation
notes.thesis: The bottoming turn and positive daily momentum argue against shorting an intact leader, but the validated risk controls say not to chase amid an extended entry and stressed broad tape. The profile itself finds no clear edge, so neither relative direction is sufficiently supported.
evidence: Weekly timeframe has not turned; prior cycle was left-translated
notes.dissent: The strongest bearish case is that the left-translated prior cycle, contracting liquidity and 64.4% net-income decline turn the apparent bottom into another early failure.

falsifier.text: Sustained relative strength versus the S&P 500 accompanied by a confirmed weekly upturn would make neutrality too conservative.

notes.name: Universal Health Services
notes.thesis: The daily bottoming setup, right-translated cycle and positive trend measures make a directional short inappropriate, while the extension and crowded Health Care basket activate the shipped do-not-chase controls. With a neutral verdict and no validated rank edge, watching for confirmation is more defensible than projecting outperformance.
evidence: Right-translated cycle; above both major moving averages
Entry axis unblocked but broad tape is stressed
Crowded and stretched Health Care basket caution
notes.dissent: The bear case is that crowded positioning, contracting liquidity and a still-unconfirmed weekly turn cause the rebound to fade and UHS to lag the index.

falsifier.text: A confirmed weekly upturn with continued relative outperformance versus the S&P 500 would make the neutral stance too cautious.

notes.name: BlackSky Technology Inc
notes.thesis: The short-term turn is countered by genuine structural weakness: BKSY remains below its 200-day average, its prior cycle was left-translated, and its industry basket is below its long-term trend. Those risk signals—not its board rank—support a modest expectation of continued S&P 500 underperformance.
evidence: Space Economy basket is below its long-term trend
Macro risk elevated for a macro-sensitive name
notes.dissent: The rejected low, recovery above the rising 10-day average and positive MACD could mark an early durable reversal before the weekly trend confirms. (softened: strong leader, momentum intact — extension is not a short (cautious-on-leader historically ~17% right); watch, don't chase)

falsifier.text: A sustained move above the 200-day average with relative strength versus the S&P 500 would overturn the cautious read.

notes.name: Royal Gold
notes.thesis: RGLD has the cleanest trend alignment in the group: a fresh-buy state, bullish weekly agreement and price above both major averages. The constructive lean rests on that with-trend setup and unblocked entry, while low conviction reflects the neutral profile verdict, macro headwind and weak directional track record.
evidence: Bigger picture bullish; weekly timeframe agrees
Accounting flag: watch; elevated macro risk
notes.dissent: Contracting liquidity, elevated macro sensitivity and an accounting-quality watch could overwhelm the trend, while the late investor phase leaves less room for error.

falsifier.text: Loss of the 50-day average together with a bearish weekly turn and relative underperformance versus the S&P 500 would negate the constructive read.

notes.name: TransMedics Group, Inc.
notes.thesis: The deterministic profile identifies relative weakness, and the rebound remains below the 200-day average with poor selection, entry and accounting readings. The fresh daily turn prevents an avoid call, but the shipped weakness and risk controls support expecting lag versus the S&P 500.
notes.dissent: Exceptional reported net-income growth, strong margins and the new daily momentum turn could drive a sharp recovery that outruns the index.

falsifier.text: A sustained recovery above the 200-day average with improving relative strength versus the S&P 500 would invalidate the cautious stance.

notes.name: StepStone Group
notes.thesis: Despite a bullish fresh-buy cycle, the deterministic verdict still identifies relative weakness and STEP remains below its 200-day average. That genuine lagging signal, plus contracting liquidity and accounting-quality caution, supports a restrained bearish-relative lean rather than treating the cycle turn as validated alpha.
evidence: Contracting liquidity and elevated macro risk
notes.dissent: The weekly-aligned fresh-buy signal, positive MACD and strong quality factor could carry STEP through its 200-day average and sustain index-beating momentum.

falsifier.text: A sustained move above the 200-day average with continued weekly strength and S&P 500 outperformance would overturn the cautious read.
